scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix backend && npm run test --prefix frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build:e2e-server: npm run build --prefix backend && tsc -p backend/tsconfig.e2e-server.json
scripts.test:browser: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:e2e-server && playwright test
